entries.name: 能源科技
entries.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup / game technology illustration. Generate ONE isolated sci-fi engineering object as a TRANSPARENT PNG asset for the existing Chinese game 银河帝国's research UI. The reference image is ONLY the approved material, lighting, and industrial technology illustration STYLE. Do not reproduce the UI page, text, background, blueprint, labels or panels. We will independently draw blueprint layers behind this subject in the actual game. Style: Starfield-inspired plausible NASA industrial engineering, finely machined pale titanium, off-white ceramic, graphite details, very restrained blue-white functional light, understated worn metal, premium realistic studio product render. Three-quarter view, entire object visible, square 1024x1024 composition with clear margins at least 10% on each side; strong readable distinctive silhouette, object occupies about 76% of canvas, centered, physically legible at 160px UI thumbnail. Neutral soft key light from upper-left, gentle rim light makes edges visible against a dark UI. No enclosing frame, no card, no floor, no cast shadow plane, no background gradient, no stars, no diagram lines, no lettering, numbers or watermark. Genuinely transparent background/alpha, not checkerboard artwork. Soft glows must remain tight to object. 
Subject: A spherical fusion containment reactor, open segmented titanium cage surrounding one restrained soft white-blue plasma core, concentric mechanical rings, clean distinctive round silhouette.
